Name: N3rd's Pets
Author: N3rdGirl64
Description:
[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/0PPnuQJ.png[/img]
This mod is an updated version of my Dog Substitution mod. It's main purpose is to add my pets to the game. (Right now there's only a few of my pets but I plan on adding more.) You will be able to start a new save and choose one of the animals as a pet or you can adopt them later on from Marnie.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RK7MTYt.png[/img]
Drag into your mods folder, you will also need Content Patcher

[img]https://i.imgur.com/b6c2IjM.png[/img]
This mod [b]SHOULD[/b] be compatible with all other mods

[img]https://i.imgur.com/prY2LJu.png[/img]
If anything goes wrong with the mod, please post a bug report and include your [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI Log[/url] or else I won't be able to help you with your issue.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3IoxJ6a.png[/img]
Boo was designed by me
Java was designed by my friend Eros.
Pixie, Mickey, Duke, Daisy, and Boo V2 were designed by strawhatwem
You can use/edit Boo.png, but not the others



My [url=https://github.com/N3rdGirl64/Stardew-Mods]GitHub[/url]﻿ [/size]

Added 6 new dogs.
Jacob, Pixie, Duke, Daisy, Mickey, and a version 2 of Boo in case people still want to use the original Boo sprites.
